review.method: Each source PDF table was reviewed row-by-row against this complete canonical result, including continued venue rows, multi-page rows, and absent source values.
normalisationRules: Spaces are removed from module codes.
Repeated source rows for one activity at the same day and time are one event with an ordered venue list.
EP and EL lecture language values are represented as E by the supported adapter contract.
Dated tests and exams use date with day set to null; recurring lectures use day with date set to null.
Exam endTime is the supported three-hour duration derived from Start Time.
Missing exam venues remain empty and produce VENUE_MISSING; no venue is inferred.
